responsibility: Implements the driver-side URLification helper that turns quoted GCC attribute names mentioned in diagnostics or pretty-printed output into links to the corresponding GCC manual sections. It owns the lookup logic over generated attribute-to-documentation tables from attr-urls.def, handles disambiguation between common and target-specific attributes using targetm.documentation_name, strips attribute arguments down to the leading identifier, and produces documentation URL suffixes or full manual URLs for the pretty-print/diagnostic URLifier framework, with selftests covering common and target-specific attribute cases.
